ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.

2. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. No full stops
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. Only one word repeated

4. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library?

5. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goes
   C. goed
   D. going

6. When practising Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks, which approach is best? (1 mark)
